notes: IMDeezNutz ($DEEZ, 1,000,000,000 tokens, 18 decimals) relaunch on Ethereum mainnet as a Uniswap v4 hook token paired with $IMD. The factory deploys four contracts in this order. DeezLaunch(requester = $owner, poolManager = 0x000000000004444c5dc75cB358380D2e3dE08A90 the Uniswap v4 PoolManager on mainnet, pairedCurrency = 0xd34a99bc0f67ae1bbd63c660e6d0b0dd03e263b7 the $IMD token) is the one-shot launcher: the requester alone may call launch(token, rewards, liquidityLock, hookSalt) once. DeezToken(launcher = DeezLaunch) is the fixed-supply ERC-20 that mints the whole 1,000,000,000 $DEEZ to the launcher in its constructor; no owner, mint, burn or pause. DeezRewards(token = DeezToken, rewardToken = $IMD, poolManager, launcher = DeezLaunch) is the daily-epoch holder reward distributor; its hook is set once by the launcher. DeezLiquidityLock(poolManager, rewards = DeezRewards) holds permanent liquidity with no owner and no removal; it reads the hook from the distributor. DeezHook is not a manifest contract: the launch transaction deploys it with CREATE2 and an off-chain mined salt so its address carries the hook permission bits (0x20CC), records it in DeezRewards, opens the DEEZ/IMD pool (fee 12500 = 1.25%, tick spacing 60) at 2,500 $IMD for the whole supply, sends 980,000,000 $DEEZ (98%) to DeezLiquidityLock and locks it single-sided, then sends 10,000,000 $DEEZ of the requester's 2% to DeezLiquidityLock and locks it in the same transaction, and transfers the remaining 10,000,000 $DEEZ to the requester wallet. The hook takes 2% of the $IMD side of every swap for holder rewards. No contract has an owner, admin, upgrade or sweep; $owner is only the requester: the sole caller of launch and the recipient of the unlocked 10,000,000 $DEEZ. All constructors are nonpayable, take static arguments and make no external call; the PoolManager and $IMD addresses are passed in and only used after deployment. Addresses, pool id and transaction hashes are published after deployment by filling site/deez.config.js from the factory record and the launch transaction.
